international.title: Trump orders contractors to check with White House over any congressional inquiries
international.summary: Anticipating flood of Democratic requests, US president issues executive order in attempt to stymie oversight efforts Donald Trump is directing federal contractors and subcontractors to consult with his administration about inquiries they receive from Congress and to withhold any communications that the White House considers privileged, according to an executive order issued late Friday. The companies must also coordinate with the White House and US agencies on “appropriate responses” to any such requests, the order says. If they fail to comply, the White House warns, their contracts could be terminated and their future work with the federal government suspended. Continue reading...
